docs.title: 2026 年 AI 代理和 MCP 服务器的最佳身份验证平台
docs.text:
Best Authentication Platforms for AI Agents and MCP Servers in 2026 摘要：随着 MCP 每月 SDK 下载量超过 9700 万次，并且 AI 代理进入生产工作流程，身份验证已成为基础设施决策团队面临的最关键问题。本指南对八个领先平台进行了排名：WorkOS、Stytch、Auth0 by Okta、Composio、Nango、Arcade、TrueFoundry 和 Cloudf

原文：As MCP crosses 97 million monthly SDK downloads and AI agents move into production workflows, authentication has become the most critical infrastructure decision teams face. This guide ranks the eight leading platforms — WorkOS, Stytch, Auth0 by Okta, Composio, Nango, Arcade, TrueFoundry, and Cloudf 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: WorkOS 发布 auth.md：基于 OAuth 标准构建的开放代理注册协议
docs.text:
WorkOS Releases auth.md: An Open Agent Registration Protocol Built on OAuth Standards 摘要：大多数网络应用程序仍然没有结构化的方式供人工智能代理注册。 auth.md 提出了一个修复方案：应用程序在其域中发布一个 Markdown 文件，告诉代理支持哪些注册流程、要请求哪些范围以及如何获取与真实用户关联的凭据 - 无需人工填写

原文：Most web applications still have no structured way for an AI agent to register. auth.md proposes a fix: a Markdown file apps publish at their domain that tells agents which registration flows are supported, which scopes to request, and how to get credentials tied to a real user — without a human fil 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Together AI 开源 OSCAR：用于长上下文 LLM 服务的注意力感知 2 位 KV 缓存量化系统
docs.text:
Together AI Open-Sources OSCAR: An Attention-Aware 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization System for Long-Context LLM Serving 摘要：Together AI 发布了 OSCAR（离线谱协方差感知旋转），这是一种用于长上下文 LLM 服务的 INT2 KV 缓存量化方法。与之前应用数据忽略哈达玛变换的基于旋转的方法不同，OSCAR 从注意力 aw 中导出键和值的单独旋转

原文：Together AI has released OSCAR (Offline Spectral Covariance-Aware Rotation), an INT2 KV cache quantization method for long-context LLM serving. Unlike prior rotation-based approaches that apply data-oblivious Hadamard transforms, OSCAR derives separate rotations for keys and values from attention-aw 来源：MarkTechPost

Together AI Open-Sources OSCAR: An Attention-Aware 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization System for Long-Context LLM Serving 摘要：Together AI 发布了 OSCAR（离线谱协方差感知旋转），这是一种用于长上下文 LLM 服务的 INT2 KV 缓存量化方法。与之前应用数据忽略哈达玛变换的基于旋转的方法不同，OSCAR 从注意力 aw 中导出键和值的单独旋转

原文：Together AI has released OSCAR (Offline Spectral Covariance-Aware Rotation), an INT2 KV cache quantization method for long-context LLM serving. Unlike prior rotation-based approaches that apply data-oblivious Hadamard transforms, OSCAR derives separate rotations for keys and values from attention-aw 来源：MarkTechPost
